title: Video Player KMP
summary: KMP is the powerful video player can play media that you want.
description:
💜 KMPlayer, Customer Lounge is here!
👉 Feedback, ideas, and events—all welcome.
https://cobak.co/en/space/392 

Perfect video player, KMP.

KMP is video player which is the light and easy one that can be played in anytime.
It can be the best partner on your trip/commute/relax. 


[ Features ]

● Bookmark
You can add bookmark on media that you want to play later on.
Add fun & enjoyment in your foreign language study with our bookmark option.

● Support Chromecast
Can cast videos to TV through Chromecast.
Cast videos, movies, music videos and more to your TV!

● Universal application
It can be played in tablet or smartphone everywhere you wanted.
Watch the video whenever, wherever.

● Screen Setting
Zoom in/out, reversal(mirror mode & upside down)-you can setup your screen with dynamic performance.
Master your favorite dance with these features.

● Section Repeat
Can play A-B sction repeatly. 
Bring more fun with your study for language with this features.

● Speed control
From 0.25x slower to 4x faster, you can adjust the playback speed
Experience various speeds with the same play quality. 

● Subtitle
Enjoy the freedom of subtitle-color, location and size.
Play video with your own choice.

● Equalizer
Provide equalizer for more realistic play.
Feel the heat of concert, orchestra like where you are in there.

● Background Play
Can played the video in background.
Enjoy your video in background like audio play.

● URL(streaming) play
You can play the video from website by enter the video’s URL.
Play the video on the web with diversiform of KMP’s excellent features. 

● External storage
KMP automatically scan all video file in your device and SD card.
You can easily manage your video file in KMP.  


[ KMP access authorization ]

Required access authorization
Storage space: Request permission to browse media stored on the device

Optional access authorization
Drawing on top of other apps: Request permission to use pop-up play

You can use the KMP basic service even if you do not agree with the optional access authorization.
(However, you cannot use functions that require optional access authorization.)


We are welcoming your suggestion to make better KMP.
Email : support.kmp@kmplayer.com
recentChanges:
This update focuses on playback controls.

• Press and hold to speed up; let go and it returns to normal. The boost no longer carries into the next video.
• Volume keeps working after you adjust brightness.
• Fixed sound not returning when you cancel a seek.
• Fixed input not registering in the network (SMB) login dialog.

These came from your reviews. Leave one if anything feels off.

Thanks for watching with KMPlayer.
